Create a keystore, convert it to base64 and paste it into GitHub Secrets right on your phone, no computer needed. You can also store secrets for websites and web apps.
Data is encrypted with a key held in your device\'s secure hardware and opens only with your fingerprint or screen lock. The app has no Internet permission, so nothing leaves the device.
Losing your phone means losing your keys. After creating the vault you will set a backup passphrase and choose where to store copies. Do it right away so you never lose keys again.
Back up before you rely on it

The vault uses an AES key in the Android Keystore that works only for 30 seconds after you authenticate. Screenshots are blocked. The app locks itself when you leave, per the setting above. It has no Internet permission and opts out of Android cloud backup.
